meta.name: internal-comms
meta.description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按公司模板撰写各类内部通知与报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁撰写公司内部沟通文档。
copy.tagline_en: Write internal communications using company-approved formats.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write internal company communications.

howto.what: 当你要写内部沟通材料时，Claude 会先判断属于哪一类沟通，再从 examples/ 目录加载对应的格式指南，按其中的格式、语气和内容要求写出草稿。类型对不上现有指南时，它会先问你要什么格式。
howto.when: 当你要求写内部沟通材料时接管，比如 3P 更新、公司简报、FAQ 等；若类型与现有指南都不匹配，它会先向你确认格式。

say.text: 帮我写一份这周的 3P 更新
say.note: 会加载 3p-updates 指南并按其中格式产出

say.text: 写一篇公司简报，讲新办公区搬迁
起草一份 FAQ，回答报销新政的常见问题
say.note: 会套用 faq-answers 指南的写法

howto.what_en: For internal communications, Claude identifies the type, loads the matching guideline from examples/, and drafts using that file's format, tone, and content rules. If none matches, it asks for the format.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever you ask for internal communications — 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, and more. If the type matches no guideline, it asks you to clarify the format.

say_en.text: Draft a company newsletter about the office move
Draft an FAQ on the new expense policy
